items.description: Cult actress Luana Anders plays a teenager trying to fit into a new community, make new friends and coexist with her abusive aunt and insensitive father, who insists she's a pyromaniac despite her pleas of innocence. Things are certain to get hot sooner than later.
items.title: One Step Beyond S1 E16 THE BURNING GIRL

items.description: Following the death of his father, young lawyer Dan Gardner discovers that his father had bought an old vaudeville theatre which has been shut down for many years. Unable to work out his father's interest in the building, he travels back in time to discover a romantic secret from the old man's past.
